channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Oct 19
item.description:
62 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Tall cliff slope prefabs now include side anchors, eliminating geometry gaps that could affect movement.
  • Container ordering is fixed when jumping with the bumper buttons in D‑pad controller mode, preventing misplaced items.
  • Gamepad glyph icons no longer overlap in the inventory on certain resolutions and aspect ratios.
  • Code‑lock light quads are correctly culled after reuse, so they no longer stay visible at any distance.
  • Reduced memory allocations for large bases, cutting LOD component overhead from 417 KB to 15 KB, which lessens stutter when many structures are loaded.
  • Removed map marker artifacting on cargo ships, ensuring the marker displays cleanly.
  • Stopped distant particle effects (conveyor flashes, furnace heat shimmers) from playing when out of view, fixing visual noise and shaving ~0.15 ms on particle processing.
  • Eliminated a brief swarm of loose bees that appeared near the hand when throwing a bee grenade.
  • Added a missing check to prevent helicopter rumble sounds from playing when the helicopter is off.
  • Enabled culling of door controller lights, saving ~0.2 ms on light processing for dozens of doors.

World & Environment

  • Coconut tree spawns are now rarer—chance reduced to 25%, network range lowered, and they no longer appear on certain palm trees.
  • Apple and beehive spawn chances on oak trees have been increased, making these resources more common.
  • Tall cliff slope prefabs now include side anchors, eliminating geometry gaps that could affect movement.

Lighthouse Mechanics

  • All lighthouses in a network share the same resource and repair progress, simplifying maintenance.

Inventory & UI

  • Container ordering is fixed when jumping with the bumper buttons in D‑pad controller mode, preventing misplaced items.
  • Gamepad glyph icons no longer overlap in the inventory on certain resolutions and aspect ratios.
  • Cooking UI now features a dedicated list of craftable items, an “All” button, and toggleable category groups for clearer navigation.

Visual & Lighting

  • Code‑lock light quads are correctly culled after reuse, so they no longer stay visible at any distance.

Visual & Performance Fixes

  • Reduced memory allocations for large bases, cutting LOD component overhead from 417 KB to 15 KB, which lessens stutter when many structures are loaded.
  • Removed map marker artifacting on cargo ships, ensuring the marker displays cleanly.
  • Stopped distant particle effects (conveyor flashes, furnace heat shimmers) from playing when out of view, fixing visual noise and shaving ~0.15 ms on particle processing.
  • Eliminated a brief swarm of loose bees that appeared near the hand when throwing a bee grenade.
  • Added a missing check to prevent helicopter rumble sounds from playing when the helicopter is off.
  • Enabled culling of door controller lights, saving ~0.2 ms on light processing for dozens of doors.
  • Fixed broken third‑person shading on the crossbow mesh, restoring proper visual appearance.
  • Corrected minigun bullet visuals so they no longer clip through nearby surfaces, matching the server‑side damage behavior.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Oct 18
item.description:

Farming & UI

Vehicle & Animal Transport
